independence: Separate reviewer received actual rendered media and a neutral brief.

journeyVerification.runtime: Task-owned Sounding Line V3 production build, isolated SQLite and two paired Chromium contexts
verified: Keyboard opt-in in Voyage device settings persists after reload. The checkbox and label stay adjacent and aligned in both contexts.
Camera gestures arm and complete the pinned Chart transfer through Crossdeck.
The receiving Chart opens automatically and acknowledges its rendered view.
One exact command retry after response loss produces one acknowledged handoff.
Animation is present with normal motion and suppressed with reduced motion.

reviewObservations.observation: The checked control sits beside its per-device label on a single row. The camera guidance appears directly below, and a separate section contains pairing fields.
The Chart drawer distinguishes the carried state, the check for a receiving device, and the acknowledgement in a consistent, readable position.
The reduced-motion presentation preserves the carried instruction and the readable Journal fallback. Each state is available as text.
The desktop retains a visible drawer close affordance and Continue Voyage. The phone shows the same Voyage, a synced read-only Chart, and Return to Chronicle without observed horizontal clipping.

findings.observation: Readiness appears just above acknowledgement and can draw the first glance. The explicit delivered line remains visible.
The existing Chart and Journal each label their distinct objectives as Current objective. The receiving device shows the same objective as the Chart.

limits: The browser proof uses synthetic landmarks. It supplies no physical webcam, lighting or hand-recognition acceptance.
The reviewer inspected sequential frames and stills. Continuous animation quality, assistive-technology announcements and activation of the return control remain unverified by this review.
The linked recording is trimmed to the Chart interaction after pairing.

repairs.finding: The original device-settings checkbox floated above its label.
repairs.repair: Grouped the checkbox and label in a single left-aligned row with a 44-pixel label target.
